usdRate.sourceName: European Central Bank euro reference rate (USD)
usdRate.note: EUR 1 = USD 1.1172, so about EUR 0.895 per US dollar; World Bank 2025 average 0.885.

inflation_cpi.sourceName: Latvijas Vēstnesis portal (lvportals.lv), citing the Central Statistical Bureau, September 2026 CPI
inflation_cpi.note: Consumer prices rose 3.2% in September 2026 compared with September 2025; read on the state legal information portal (lvportals.lv) reporting the Central Statistical Bureau release, because the CSB release page was not found.

inflation_projection.sourceName: ECB 2% inflation target; Latvian CPI 3.2% (Sep 2026), 3.7% in 2025 (World Bank)
inflation_projection.note: Latvia uses the euro, so long-run inflation should converge toward the ECB 2% target, but Baltic price catch-up keeps it somewhat higher, so 2.5% is used.

policy_rate.sourceName: European Central Bank, deposit facility rate
policy_rate.note: Latvia is in the euro area; the ECB deposit facility rate is 2.50% from 16 September 2026.

savings_account_rate.sourceName: ECB MFI interest rate statistics, Latvia, overnight deposits from households
savings_account_rate.note: Average rate on household overnight (demand) deposits, new business, September 2026 (0.42% also in August); includes ordinary savings accounts.

fdr_3m_rate.note: Latvijas Banka and the ECB publish household term-deposit rates only for the up-to-1-year bucket (2.75% in September 2026), not 3 months separately.

fdr_1y_rate.sourceName: ECB MFI interest rate statistics, Latvia, household deposits with agreed maturity up to 1 year (new business)
fdr_1y_rate.note: New household term deposits with agreed maturity up to 1 year, September 2026 (2.52% in August, 2.31% in July).

dps_rate.note: No published average rate for monthly recurring deposits in Latvia.

bank_deposit_avg_rate.sourceName: ECB MFI interest rate statistics, Latvia, household deposits with agreed maturity (outstanding amounts)
bank_deposit_avg_rate.note: Average rate on the stock of household deposits with agreed maturity (outstanding amounts), September 2026 (2.48% in August).

sanchayapatra_5y_rate.sourceName: iFinanses (news), State Treasury savings bonds rates
sanchayapatra_5y_rate.note: State Treasury savings bonds (krājobligācijas) for individuals pay 3.85% a year for 5 years (6 months 3.00%, 12 months 3.30%, 10 years 4.30%) in early October 2026; secondary source because the savings bond site is script-only.

tbill_91d_rate.note: The State Treasury does not regularly issue 3-month bills to the public; its monthly bulletin for September 2026 lists only medium-term GMTN auctions.

tbond_5y_rate.note: No published 5-year Latvian government bond yield could be read (auction rates appear only as charts in the State Treasury bulletin).

tbond_10y_rate.sourceName: ECB long-term interest rate for convergence purposes, Latvia (10-year government bond yield)
tbond_10y_rate.note: Monthly average 10-year Latvian government bond yield, September 2026 (3.82% in August).

tax_bank_interest.sourceName: PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries, Latvia, income determination
tax_bank_interest.note: Interest income of individuals is taxed at 25.5%, usually withheld by Latvian payers.

tax_sanchayapatra_profit.note: Interest on State Treasury savings bonds is not taxed, unlike bank deposit interest; secondary source.

deposit_insurance_limit.note: Up to EUR 100,000 per depositor per bank or credit union (page updated 3 June 2025).

credit_card_rate_cap.sourceName: ECB MFI interest rate statistics, Latvia, revolving loans, overdrafts and credit card credit to households
credit_card_rate_cap.note: No specific card-rate cap found; this is the average rate on household revolving loans, overdrafts and extended credit card credit in September 2026 (17.51% in August).

equity_return_low.sourceName: Global equity index in euro terms (S&P 500 +10.8% in a year to Oct 2026); Latvia's own stock exchange is very small
equity_return_low.note: Low case: a global index fund in euros delivers little more than safe euro rates over a long stretch, as after 2000 and 2008.

equity_return_base.sourceName: Global equity index in euro terms; savings bond 12-month rate 3.30% tax-free
equity_return_base.note: The local Riga market is too small to rely on, so the base case is a global index fund in euros about 2 points over the tax-free savings bond rate, within 4 points of the after-tax safe return.

equity_return_high.sourceName: Global equity long-run returns in euro terms
equity_return_high.note: High case: global equities match their long-run record of about 7-8% a year in euros.

gold_return_low.sourceName: Gold USD 3,876/oz on 30 Oct 2026, 31% below the January 2026 high
gold_return_low.note: Low case: gold barely keeps up after the 2025-26 spike, with no help from the euro.

gold_return_base.sourceName: Gold price history (Trading Economics); ECB 2% inflation target
gold_return_base.note: Base case: dollar gold rises with world inflation plus a little, and the euro is assumed stable against the dollar over the long run.

gold_return_high.note: High case: a repeat of gold's strong 2005-2025 trend in euro terms.

fixed_income_return_low.sourceName: ECB MIR Latvia: household deposits up to 1 year 2.75% (Sep 2026) less 25.5% tax
fixed_income_return_low.note: Low case: bank term deposits after the 25.5% tax on interest (about 2.0%), with some time in near-zero overnight deposits.

fixed_income_return_base.sourceName: State Treasury savings bonds 3.30% (12 months) to 3.85% (5 years), tax-free
fixed_income_return_base.note: Base case: a mix of tax-free savings bonds and taxed term deposits, a little below today's savings bond rates because euro rates may drift lower.

fixed_income_return_high.note: High case: locking in longer tax-free savings bonds near current rates.

life_claim_settlement_rate.note: Latvijas Banka (insurance supervisor) publishes no industry life claim settlement ratio that could be found.

insurance_term_premium_table.note: No regulator or official published term life premium data was found; only insurer quotes exist, which may not be cited.

health_hospitalisation_cost.note: No published figure for the typical out-of-pocket cost of a private hospital stay was found.

health_premium_table.note: No regulator or official published voluntary health insurance premium table was found.

oop_health_share.note: Out-of-pocket spending was 35.1% of current health expenditure in 2023 (older than 2025; latest available).

goal_inflation_health.note: Medical costs are assumed to rise about 1.5 points faster than general inflation, as wages in health care catch up with the EU.

goal_inflation_education.sourceName: Latvian CPI 3.2% (Sep 2026), with higher education fees reviewed upward in September 2026
goal_inflation_education.note: Private and higher education fees are assumed to rise about one point faster than general inflation.

life_expectancy.sourceName: Eurostat, life expectancy by age and sex (demo_mlexpec)
life_expectancy.note: Men 71.4, women 81.2 in 2024 (latest Eurostat year; older than 2025). World Bank 2024 also 76.4.

life_table_remaining.sourceName: Eurostat, life expectancy by age and sex (demo_mlexpec)
life_table_remaining.note: Remaining life expectancy at each age in 2024, the latest year Eurostat publishes (older than 2025).

support_ratio.sourceName: Eurostat EUROPOP2023 population projections, old-age dependency ratio (proj_23ndbi, baseline)
support_ratio.note: 100 / projected old-age dependency ratio of 35.5 (2026), 45.3 (2040) and 58.8 (2065); the observed ratio was 34.7 in 2025.

retirement_age_default.sourceName: State Social Insurance Agency (VSAA), granting and payment of the old-age pension
retirement_age_default.note: Retirement age is 65 for men and women from 2025 (Law on State Pensions, transitional provisions), with at least 20 years of insurance; no further increase is legislated, so it applies to people born after 1975.

retirement_age_government.sourceName: State Social Insurance Agency (VSAA), granting and payment of the old-age pension
retirement_age_government.note: Civil servants receive the general state old-age pension at 65; separate service pensions apply only to specific groups such as police and military.

retirement_return_low.sourceName: ECB MIR Latvia: household deposits up to 1 year 2.75% (Sep 2026) less 25.5% tax
retirement_return_low.note: Low case: a retiree holding mostly bank deposits after the 25.5% interest tax.

retirement_return_base.note: Base case kept below the tax-free 12-month savings bond rate of 3.3%, the best safe 1-year option.

retirement_return_high.note: High case: a ladder of longer tax-free savings bonds.

retirement_accumulation_return_low.sourceName: Global equity low case 3%; fixed income low case 1.8%
retirement_accumulation_return_low.note: Low case for a balanced mix if global shares lag.

retirement_accumulation_return_base.sourceName: Global equity base 5.5%; fixed income base 2.8%
retirement_accumulation_return_base.note: Base case: roughly half global shares and half savings bonds and deposits.

retirement_accumulation_return_high.sourceName: Global equity high 7.5%; fixed income high 3.8%
retirement_accumulation_return_high.note: High case for a growth-leaning balanced mix.

old_age_allowance_monthly.sourceName: State Social Insurance Agency (VSAA), state social security benefit
old_age_allowance_monthly.note: For people of pension age with no pension of their own: 22% of the income median (VSAA English page); from 1 January 2026 the income median used is EUR 850.02 a month (VSAA Latvian page), so the benefit is about EUR 187.00 a month (EUR 166.04 in 2025). The euro amount is calculated from these two official figures.

old_age_allowance_eligibility.sourceName: State Social Insurance Agency (VSAA), state social security benefit
old_age_allowance_eligibility.note: Paid from the state pension age (65) to permanent residents with at least 60 months of residence (the last 12 continuous) who do not qualify for an old-age, disability or survivor's pension; no income or asset test, but a foreign pension reduces it.

gratuity_rule.note: No statutory end-of-service gratuity for private employees was found in the sources reviewed (web search budget ran out before the Labour Law could be checked), so it is not marked absent.

public_pension_scheme.sourceName: Law on State Pensions (Sections 11 and 26), likumi.lv; VSAA old-age pension page for tax
public_pension_scheme.note: Mandatory notional-account state pension (1st tier) plus funded 2nd tier: pension from 65 with at least 20 insurance years (Section 11; 65 from 1 January 2025). Pensions are reviewed every 1 October by the actual CPI plus 50-80% of contribution wage growth depending on insurance years (Section 26). VSAA: pensions above the EUR 1,000 monthly non-taxable minimum are taxed at 25.5%. The English translation read is the 2024 consolidated version.

dps.note: No standard monthly recurring deposit product with a published rate was confirmed.

sanchayapatra_5y.note: Sold by the State Treasury to individuals for 6 months, 12 months, 5 and 10 years; interest tax-free; EUR 503 million held at end-September 2026.

tbill_91d.note: Short-term bills are not regularly offered to retail investors; 6- and 12-month savings bonds fill that role.

tbond_5y.note: Auctioned by the State Treasury on the domestic market, mainly to banks and institutions.

equity_fund.note: EU-wide funds and ETFs are sold to retail investors; Latvia's own exchange is small.

gold.note: No restriction on buying physical gold; investment gold is VAT-exempt under EU rules.

centralBank.name: Latvijas Banka
centralBank.note: Part of the Eurosystem; monetary policy is set by the European Central Bank.

pensionScheme.name: Valsts sociālās apdrošināšanas aģentūra (State Social Insurance Agency), old-age pension

oldAgeAllowance.name: Valsts sociālā nodrošinājuma pabalsts (state social security benefit)
